Name: PinkStations Riverland Farm Map
Author: PinkStations
Description:
[size=2][size=4][b]~PinkStations Riverland Farm~[/b][/size][b]
[/b]My prettier and organized Riverland farm map. It has a heart shaped beehive area, designated spaces for farm animals (they cannot pass over the bridges), Designated areas for all your buildings, and a nice spacious farming area! I've added a labeled picture to show where everything is ideally placed.

If you love this map but want to freestyle it yourself there's also a clean version. Do whatever you'd like and feel free to share a screenshot! I'd love to see what you can do with it!

You can change the farm layout (Decorated or Clean) from the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] or changing directly in the config file!

[size=3][b]Requirements:[/b][/size]
~ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]Smapi[/url]﻿[/size][size=3][size=2]
~ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
~ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]DaisyNiko's Tilesheets[/url]﻿

[/size][b]How to Install:
[/b][size=2]~ Download and then unzip[/size]
[size=2]~[/size][/size][size=2] Put the unzipped folder into your mods folder
~ Run the game and pick the Riverland Farm
